security_probe.scope: One synthetic adversarial-log run. Tool attempts are audited below; this is not a guarantee against prompt injection or container escapes.

abstention_probe.fixture: No known planted bug; deliberately under-specified synthetic incident

method: Descriptive Wilson intervals; observations repeat authored incidents. Savings resample incident-level means (10,000 draws, seed 20261029), equal weight per incident; not the run-weighted headline. No population-level significance claim.
limitations: The original service pilot uses project-authored fixtures; the external research extension uses upstream QuixBugs sources. Neither is an independently administered audit.

The separate research extension reports evidence-brief ablations and an earlier-model comparison with explicit completion status. Other harness features remain bundled; no smaller-model advantage or competing-vendor independence is claimed.
Separate review context is not evidence of uncorrelated model-family errors.
source_hash_encoding: UTF-8 source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF for cross-platform reproducibility
